channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tommy Sheppard | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tommy Sheppard from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Bartelstein on Ernie Grunfeld, Tommy Sheppard, Michael Winger
item.description:
“From the day that Ted drafted Brad he has been by our side along with [former general managers] Ernie Grunfeld and Tommy Sheppard. They've always had Brad's back in every way and now we have experienced the exact same thing with Ted and Michael Winger. We are extremely grateful.”

Mark Bartelstein on Ernie Grunfeld, Tommy Sheppard, Michael Winger, Jun 18, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Ted Leonsis on Tommy Sheppard
item.description:
Statement from Ted Leonsis:

“Tommy Sheppard was relieved from his duties as GM and Pres. of the Washington Wizards. Failure to make the playoffs the last two seasons was very disappointing to our organization and our fans.”

Ted Leonsis on Tommy Sheppard, Apr 19, 2023. Source: Twitter @JoshuaBRobbins.

item.title: Marcin Gortat on Ernie Grunfeld, Tommy Sheppard
item.description:
Durant, on the other hand, would entertain Gortat's half-joking recruitment attempts whenever the Thunder came to the District.

“I was helping. I was helping (general manager) Tommy (Sheppard), I was helping (former general manager) Ernie (Grunfeld).It was the time everyone was talking about KD, obviously later he signed with Golden State, but hey, everybody was trying to get KD. I was like let me help out,”

Marcin Gortat on Ernie Grunfeld, Tommy Sheppard, Apr 28, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Tommy Sheppard, Bradley Beal
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Scott Brooks on trade speculation involving Bradley Beal:

“We're not interested. I think I might tell Tommy [Sheppard] to block all the 29 other GM's numbers. We're not answering.”

Scott Brooks on Tommy Sheppard, Bradley Beal, Jan 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Ted Leonsis on Tommy Sheppard
item.description:
Eventually, Leonsis didn't see Sheppard as the extension of an outdated regime that he ousted, but the unleashing of a progressive mind who understood that the modern duties of a GM required the supporting cast that Leonsis has invested to bring to the franchise.

“I like [Sheppard's] dexterity to be able to deal with the existing NBA, but to also really look at it as a global enterprise,”

Ted Leonsis on Tommy Sheppard, Jul 22, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Ted Leonsis on Tommy Sheppard, Scott Brooks
item.description:
“I am very happy with the work and preparation Tommy Sheppard, Coach [Scott] Brooks and our staff have done and I’m confident we’ll execute both the draft and free agency in an expert manner,”

Ted Leonsis on Tommy Sheppard, Scott Brooks, Jun 18, 2019. Source: Washington Post.
